title: Term Life Insurance
intro: Indian term plans compared on the insurer's FY2024-25 death-claim record and the plan's price, cover age and built-in benefits; get a quote for your own age and cover before buying.
sources: IRDAI Handbook on Indian Insurance Statistics 2024-25 (Part I, Tables 10, 15, 21, 37)
Insurer product pages, brochures and prospectuses (Oct 2026)
joinditto.in term plan reviews and Rs 1 crore premium comparisons (2026)

params.label: Claim settlement (by count)
params.tip: Insurer's individual death claims paid as % of claims decided, FY2024-25 (IRDAI). Industry: 97.82%. Insurer-wide, not plan-specific.

params.label: Claim settlement (by amount)
params.tip: Value of the insurer's individual death claims paid as % of value decided, FY2024-25 (IRDAI). Industry: 96.29%.

params.label: Solvency ratio
params.tip: Insurer's available vs required capital as at 31 Mar 2025 (IRDAI). Legal minimum is 1.5x.

params.label: Premium, Rs 1 Cr to age 70
params.tip: Annual premium for a 30-year-old male non-smoker, Rs 1 crore cover to age 70, base cover without riders (Ditto comparisons or insurer brochure, 2026). Indicative only; individual life policies are GST-exempt since 22 Sep 2025.

params.label: Other premium quotes
params.tip: Other sourced premium examples on a different basis (age, cover-to age or sum assured stated). Not comparable across plans.

params.label: Max cover age
params.tip: Highest age to which the plan can cover you, in its longest option (insurer documents or aggregators, Oct 2026).

params.label: Terminal illness benefit
params.tip: Whether the base plan pays (some or all of) the cover early on diagnosis of a terminal illness, at no extra cost.

params.label: Return of premium option
params.tip: Whether the plan offers a return-of-premium variant. ROP costs much more and returns premiums without interest.

params.label: Riders & add-ons
params.tip: Optional riders or add-on covers named in insurer documents or aggregator reviews, Oct 2026.

params.label: Complaints per 10,000 policies
params.tip: Insurer's grievances in FY2024-25 per 10,000 individual policies in force at 31 Mar 2025; computed from IRDAI Tables 37 and 10.

items.name: HDFC Life Click 2 Protect Supreme Plus

v.premiumNote: Older Click 2 Protect Supreme (being phased out): Rs 14,241/yr, age 30, Rs 1 Cr to 65 (Ditto)
v.riders: Health Plus (critical illness/cancer), LiveWell, Income Benefit on Accidental Disability

pros: Insurer settled 99.68% of death claims by count in FY25
Return-of-premium add-on available
Premium break, Smart Exit and life-stage cover increase options
cons: Highest Rs 1 Cr to-70 premium in the comparison: Rs 15,240/yr (Ditto)
Cover only to age 85, no whole-life option
Insurer solvency of 1.94x (Mar 2025) is below the 2x many peers hold
items.best: Buyers who put claim record ahead of price

items.name: ICICI Pru iProtect Smart Plus
items.provider: ICICI Prudential Life Insurance Company Ltd.

v.riders: Accidental death & disability, critical illness (60 conditions), waiver of premium

pros: Cheapest Rs 1 Cr to-70 quote in the comparison: Rs 12,968/yr (Ditto)
Full cover paid early on terminal illness (per Ditto)
Insurer settled 98.06% of death-claim value in FY25, above the 96.29% industry figure
cons: Cover only to age 85
No return-of-premium variant (sold as a separate iProtect Smart ROP plan)
Waiver of premium rider does not cover illness-related disability (per Ditto)
items.best: Value buyers who want a large insurer and built-in terminal illness cover

items.name: Axis Max Life Smart Term Plan Plus

v.premiumNote: Another Ditto page lists Rs 12,296/yr for Rs 1 Cr, cover-to age not stated
v.riders: Waiver of Premium Plus, Critical Illness and Disability, Accidental Death and Dismemberment; Maternity Cover add-on for women

pros: Insurer settled 99.7% of death claims by count in FY25
Whole-life variant covers to age 100
Seven variants including return of premium and Early ROP Plus
cons: Terminal illness early payout capped at Rs 1 Cr
Insurer complaints of 9.25 per 10,000 policies (FY25) are on the high side
Many variants can be confusing; no life-stage increase (per Ditto)
items.best: Buyers who want whole-life or ROP cover from a top claim payer
items.news: Axis Max Life Smart Term Plan

items.name: Tata AIA Sampoorna Raksha Promise
items.provider: Tata AIA Life Insurance Company Ltd.

v.riders: Comprehensive Protection, Comprehensive Health, Vitality Protect, Vitality Health

pros: Cover to age 100, with return-of-premium and joint-life options
Insurer settled 98.38% of death-claim value in FY25
Rs 3 lakh fast payout on claim notification; 12-month premium deferral
cons: Terminal illness pays only 50% of cover early
Insurer solvency of 1.8x (Mar 2025) is among the lowest here
Ditto calls premiums on the higher side and mentions service delays
items.best: Long or joint cover with flexible premium options

items.name: Bajaj Life eTouch II
items.provider: Bajaj Life Insurance Ltd. (formerly Bajaj Allianz Life)

v.riders: New Critical Illness Benefit, Accidental Death Benefit II, Accidental Permanent Total/Partial Disability II, Family Protect, Care Plus

pros: Highest insurer solvency here: 3.59x (Mar 2025)
Cover to age 99; full sum assured paid on terminal illness
Wide rider choice including critical illness
cons: Insurer settled only 93.04% of death-claim value in FY25 (industry 96.29%)
ROP variant costs roughly 80-100% more and stops at age 85
items.best: Long cover with many riders from a well-capitalised insurer

items.name: LIC New Tech-Term (Plan 954)

v.premiumNote: No Rs 1 Cr quote found; Ditto: Rs 28,860/yr at age 30 for Rs 2 Cr (older V01 version)

pros: Government-owned insurer with the fewest complaints among large peers: 2.76 per 10,000 (FY25)
Level or increasing cover; claim can be paid in instalments
Entry up to age 65
cons: Insurer claim settlement by count 97.59% in FY25, below the 97.82% industry figure
Only one rider and no terminal illness benefit
Premiums higher than private insurers; minimum cover Rs 50 lakh
items.best: Buyers who want a state-backed insurer for their term cover

items.name: LIC Digi Term (Plan 876)

v.premiumNote: No Rs 1 Cr quote found; Ditto: Rs 23,660/yr at age 30 for Rs 2 Cr

pros: Government-owned insurer with low complaints: 2.76 per 10,000 policies (FY25)
Level or increasing cover; claim can be paid in instalments
cons: Cover ends at age 75 and entry stops at 45
No riders and no terminal illness benefit
Insurer settled 96.08% of death-claim value in FY25, below the 96.29% industry figure
items.best: Younger buyers who want LIC cover bought fully online

items.name: SBI Life eShield Next

v.premiumNote: Rs 11,595/yr, age 30, 30-year term to age 60 (Ditto; sum assured not stated)
v.riders: Accidental Death, Accidental Total & Permanent Disability, Accidental Partial Permanent Disability; Better Half (spouse) benefit

pros: Low insurer complaints: 2.41 per 10,000 policies (FY25)
Whole-life option to age 100; terminal illness benefit built in
Increasing cover and future-proofing options
cons: No critical illness or waiver-of-premium rider
Terminal illness payout capped at Rs 2 Cr
Insurer settled 95.26% of death-claim value in FY25 (industry 96.29%)
items.best: Simple whole-life term from a large bank-backed insurer

items.name: Kotak e-Term
items.provider: Kotak Mahindra Life Insurance Company Ltd.

v.premiumNote: Rs 11,100/yr, age 30, Rs 1 Cr, cover-to age not stated (Ditto, Apr 2026)
v.riders: Critical Illness Plus (37 illnesses), Permanent Disability Benefit

pros: Insurer solvency of 2.45x (Mar 2025)
Several payout options plus a life-stage cover increase
Special Exit Value returns premiums on exit at 60 (long terms)
cons: No terminal illness benefit
Waiver of premium only for disability, in the Life Secure option
Payout and plan options cannot be changed after purchase
items.best: Buyers who want flexible payout options

items.name: PNB MetLife Mera Term Plan Plus
items.provider: PNB MetLife India Insurance Company Ltd.

v.premiumNote: Rs 10,400/yr excl. GST, age 30, Rs 1 Cr to age 60, Life option; Rs 23,200 with ROP (brochure)
v.riders: Accidental Death Benefit Rider Plus, Serious Illness, Accidental Disability Benefit, Critical Illness

pros: Insurer settled 99.3% of death-claim value in FY25, among the best
Lowest official Rs 1 Cr to-60 quote found: Rs 10,400/yr (brochure)
Cover to 99; spouse cover, child education benefit and limited pay
cons: Terminal illness only in the Life Plus options, not the base Life option
High insurer complaints: 11.75 per 10,000 policies (FY25)
ROP and Life Plus Health options stop at age 75
items.best: Price-conscious buyers who want a strong claim-value record

items.name: ABSLI Salaried Term Plan
items.provider: Aditya Birla Sun Life Insurance Company Ltd.

v.premiumNote: Brochure: Rs 15,400/yr excl. GST, age 35, Rs 1 Cr to 65; Rs 27,100 with ROP
v.riders: Accidental Death and Disability, ADB Rider Plus, Critical Illness, Surgical Care, Hospital Care, Waiver of Premium; Accelerated CI (42 illnesses)

pros: Terminal illness built into all options (50% paid early, waives premiums)
Four payout choices including ROP and rising income
First-year discount of up to 9%; wide rider list
cons: Salaried people only
Cover ends at 75, no whole-life option
Insurer solvency of 1.88x (Mar 2025) is below most peers
items.best: Salaried buyers who want riders and income payouts
items.news: Aditya Birla Sun Life term plan

items.name: Canara HSBC iSelect Smart360 Term Plan
items.provider: Canara HSBC Life Insurance Company Ltd.

v.premiumNote: Brochure figure excl. GST, physical medical; ROP option Rs 29,347/yr on same basis
v.riders: Built-in optional covers: accidental death, terminal illness, accidental disability, critical illness, child care, Block Your Premium

pros: Insurer settled 99.08% of death-claim value in FY25
Cover to 99; increase cover at marriage, childbirth or home purchase
Brochure publishes premium tables
cons: Terminal illness cover costs extra
High insurer complaints: 10.84 per 10,000 policies (FY25)
Replaces the withdrawn iSelect Star plan
items.best: Buyers who want to raise cover at life events

items.name: Bandhan Life iTerm Prime
items.provider: Bandhan Life Insurance Ltd. (formerly Aegon Life)
pros: Best insurer claim record here: 99.73% by count and 99.8% by value (FY25)
Low price per Ditto
Special Exit Value returns base premiums after age 55
cons: Only one rider; no terminal illness, critical illness or waiver of premium
Small insurer: AUM of Rs 4,761 crore (Mar 2025)
High insurer complaints: 10.94 per 10,000 policies (FY25)
items.best: Plain, low-cost cover where claim record matters most

items.name: Edelweiss Life Zindagi Protect Plus
items.provider: Edelweiss Life Insurance Company Ltd. (formerly Edelweiss Tokio)

v.premiumNote: Brochure: Rs 20,702/yr excl. GST, age 35, cover to 80, before 6% medical discount; Rs 44,860 with ROP
v.riders: Accidental Death Benefit, Accidental Total and Permanent Disability, Critical Illness, Waiver of Premium

pros: Cover to age 100 with an ROP option
Spouse and child cover; skip up to 8 premiums
Insurer settled 98.34% of death-claim value in FY25
cons: No terminal illness benefit
Highest insurer complaints here: 24.21 per 10,000 policies (FY25)
Replaces the discontinued Zindagi Plus; no age-30 premium published

items.name: Aviva Signature 3D Term Plan
items.provider: Aviva Life Insurance Company India Ltd.

v.riders: Critical Illness, Cancer Cardio, Accidental Casualty

pros: Limited-pay whole-life option to age 99
Return-of-premium option (3D-TROP)
cons: Terminal illness only in the 3D-Accelerated option, 50% capped at Rs 1 Cr
No sourced premium or insurer claim figures in this dataset
